page.overview:
What is Race?

The Race theme, which existed as a standalone theme in 2000, served as a direct spiritual successor to the previous Racing sub-theme that was active in the 1990s. Although short-lived, the Race theme's focus on competitive vehicles set the foundation for subsequent, more successful racing lines. Its legacy was continued and expanded upon by the long-running Racers theme and, most recently, by the highly detailed and licensed Speed Champions theme.
